title: Text and question sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: The weekend; Basem in the village; the little mouse and the lion
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 6 (Text and question sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 6: Reading: Basem in the village. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text: يَسْكُنُ جَدُّ بَاسِمٍ فِي قَرْيَةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ. فِي القَرْيَةِ بَقَرَةٌ وَدَجَاجَةٌ. يَشْرَبُ بَاسِمٌ الحَلِيبَ. يَلْعَبُ بَاسِمٌ فِي الحَقْلِ. القَرْيَةُ جَمِيلَةٌ.
arabic.ref: Our own short text for 'Basem in the village' (Kitabi version: CHECK IN KITABI)

questions.q: أَيْنَ يَلْعَبُ بَاسِمٌ؟ (Where does Basem play?)
Is the village big or small?
Name the two animals in the village.
Core: Copy the text neatly and draw the village (fields, a cow, a hen; no people).
questions.a: Neat copy with a labelled picture

questions.q: Extend: Answer in Arabic: مَاذَا يَشْرَبُ بَاسِمٌ؟
Stretch: Find the three verbs in the text (they start with يَـ).

questions.a: B) حَلِيب (milk). The text says يَشْرَبُ بَاسِمٌ الحَلِيبَ: Basem drinks the milk.

questions.q: What is قَرْيَة? A) village B) field C) cow
Big question: what helped you understand the story?
questions.a: Knowing the new words first, and using the question words who, where, what.
